_note: EDITORIAL entry points. Each question resolves to ordinary catalogue filters (OR within a filter, AND across filters), so every result is traceable to record data. `note` states known gaps honestly.

items.question: Which knowledge resources can help me develop an industrial robot?
items.explanation: Robot structure, positions, tasks and autonomy vocabularies, plus the units and sensor semantics robots depend on.
items.note: Robot software frameworks, simulators and datasets are not catalogued yet.

items.question: What semantic standards support digital-twin interoperability?
items.explanation: Asset information models and ontologies used to describe assets consistently across their lifecycle.

items.question: Which resources help connect engineering requirements with verification evidence?
items.explanation: Systems-modelling languages, simulation-related semantics and provenance vocabularies that can trace results back to their inputs.
items.note: Few public ontologies cover requirement-to-evidence traceability end to end; these resources each cover part of it.

items.question: Which reference ontologies are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing?
items.explanation: Resources mapped to the atlas Semiconductors use case, from supply-chain and classification semantics to materials, units and manufacturing ontologies.

items.question: What resources exist for lifecycle assessment and Digital Product Passports?
items.explanation: Product identification, provenance, regulation and sustainability-related semantics.
items.note: No published, verified LCA ontology is catalogued yet (one candidate is under review).

items.question: Which public resources support Physical AI and sim-to-real workflows?
items.explanation: Today the atlas covers the semantic foundations: robotics, sensing and simulation-related semantics.
items.note: Physical AI frameworks, simulators and datasets are planned for a later phase and are not catalogued yet.
